visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor studio with acoustic foam on walls. A woman with light blonde hair and a cream-colored t-shirt sits at a mahjong table, contemplating her next move while resting her chin on her hand. The lighting is bright and professional. (2) Close-up view of the mahjong table showing a hand reaching for a tile. The tiles are white with intricate Chinese characters and symbols in red, green, and black. A blue caption appears at the bottom of the frame. (3) The scene shifts to a man with bleached blonde hair wearing thick-rimmed glasses and a dark graphic t-shirt. He looks intensely at the mahjong tiles with a surprised facial expression, resting his chin on his tattooed hand. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's hands moving the mahjong tiles. She flips over a tile with a 'East' character, revealing a winning hand. The camera angle is slightly overhead to capture the layout of the tiles. (5) The group moves into a celebratory phase. The man holds up a cream t-shirt with a large print of a Corgi dog. The woman stands beside him, gesturing towards the camera with a cheerful, high-energy smile. (6) A person holds two bottles of tea from 'Yuan Cha Zhi Suo' in front of the camera. The characters discuss the drinks while pointing at the labels. The background remains the studio setup. (7) Final shot shows the two main characters sitting together, pointing at the audience and laughing. They are promoting the SML tournament. The video concludes with a black-and-white graphic displaying tournament dates and registration details.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Clear female voice speaking in a thoughtful tone, accompanied by soft clinking of mahjong tiles. Background music is low. The environmental noise is minimal, consistent with a professional studio setup. (2) A sudden, high-pitched digital 'Ding' sound effect occurs as a winning tile is revealed. This is followed by an immediate surge in vocal volume and arousal, with multiple voices cheering and laughing loudly. (3) Rhythmic, mid-tempo pop music begins playing. The male speaker's voice is bright and energetic as he describes the prize. The BGM has a strong electronic beat and synthesizer melody, providing a lively atmosphere. (4) The sound of plastic bottle rustling and liquid movement is captured as drinks are shown. The dialogue becomes a rapid-fire interaction between the interviewer and the subjects, punctuated by cartoon sound effects. (5) The audio concludes with a structured promotional announcement. The speaker's delivery is enunciated and clear, with the BGM lowering in volume to ensure the registration dates are heard clearly. A final stinger sound marks the end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Scene setup (Mahjong game) -> Climax (Winning & Prize showcase) -> Product Endorsement (Drinks) -> Event Promotion (Registration)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the SML (Star Mahjong League) tournament and the 'Yuan Cha Zhi Suo' beverage brand by showcasing an exciting game highlight and its rewards through high-energy entertainment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The characters specifically attribute their winning luck to the beverages from 'Yuan Cha Zhi Suo' and showcase the bottles prominently while encouraging viewers to 'drink it'.
